2609.39692.title: GFD-OPD: Guidance-Folded On-Policy Distillation of Diffusion Models Across Scales
2609.39692.paper_summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) has demonstrated two important capabilities in language models: compressing large teachers into smaller students and merging expert models into a single model. Existing diffusion OPD, however, mostly focus on the latter, with teachers and students sharing the same backbone and scale. We investigate large-to-small diffusion opd from large teachers to a small student and find that the standard recipe fails. To find the underlying cause, we propose Fixed-State KL, an effective and fair way to measure the distribution gap between student and teacher during OPD training for diffusion models. We are the first to clarify why large-to-small OPD is challenging for diffusion models: a smaller student struggles to perfectly match the distribution of a larger teacher, while classifier-free guidance can accumulate and amplify the distributional discrepancies between the student's conditional and unconditional branches and those of the teacher. To solve this problem, we propose GFD-OPD, a simple yet effective method that reduces the student-teacher gap while avoiding the error amplification of the CFG composition. Across numerous experiments, GFD outperforms previous baselines in both training efficiency and final performance, achieving state-of-the-art results on all benchmarks.
2609.39692.paper_summary_zh: 在政策蒸餾（OPD）中，已經展示了語言模型的兩個重要能力：將大型教師壓縮成較小的學生，以及將專家模型合併為單一模型。然而，現有的擴散 OPD 大多集中於後者，教師和學生共享相同的骨幹和規模。我們研究了從大型教師到小型學生的自大到小型擴散 OPD，發現標準配方失效。為了找出根本原因，我們提出了固定狀態 KL，這是一種有效且公平的方式，用於測量在擴散模型的 OPD 訓練中學生和教師之間的分佈差距。我們首次闡明了為什麼大型到小型 OPD 對擴散模型來說是具有挑戰性的：較小的學生難以完美匹配較大教師的分佈，而無分類器引導可能會累積並放大學生的條件和無條件分支與教師之間的分佈差異。為了解決這個問題，我們提出了 GFD-OPD，一種簡單但有效的方法，可以減少學生和教師之間的差距，同時避免 CFG 組合的錯誤放大。在大量實驗中，GFD 在訓練效率和最終性能上均超越了之前的基準，並在所有基準上達到了最先進的結果。
